messages:
marta: Hey team — quick catch on PR #4910: the API reference page shows camelCase in the raw JSON examples for /v1/generate. That causes folks who copy the curl/js examples to get 400s.
ishan: Confirming policy: raw HTTP examples should use snake_case (e.g., max_new_tokens). SDK examples keep camelCase.
prashant: I'll update openapi/generated.yml response example toothe streaming response currently only lists message.role which breaks SSE parser snippets expecting message.content.
olivia: I'll edit JS/cURL/python snippets on the page to use snake_case and include a short SSE parsing snippet showing message.content array.
ryan: I'll add a lightweight docs test that loads the OpenAPI examples and asserts the response example contains a content array so CI fails fast on regressions.
doc-bot: CI: preview built for branch fix-4910 -> https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4910 (lint OK)
marta: Example to replace (short):

Incorrect raw JSON shown in PR:
```js
fetch('/v1/generate', { body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi', maxNewTokens: 32 }) })
```

Replace with raw-API form (snake_case) and SSE note:
```js
fetch('/v1/generate', { body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi', max_new_tokens: 32, stream: true }) })
// SSE chunks include { message: { role: 'assistant', content: [{ type: 'output_text', text: '...' }] } }
```

marta: Once Docs preview looks good I'll add a one-liner to the changelog clarifying API vs SDK naming. Thanks!
